heading: Puppies Available Now - Editor Test
description:
We are expecting a new litter of puppies in mid to late July. Please text 214.406.4578 for the most up-to-date pictures and videos, or to schedule a video call.

All puppies are up-to-date on vaccinations and come with a health guarantee and full breeding rights. The prices of the puppies vary depending on sex and color.

Delivery is available, and we can always work with you to find the perfect delivery date for your puppy.
